A '''skirmish''' occurred at a point in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] near and aboard the [[Unidentified medical supply ship|medical supply ship]] captured on [[Fhost]]. [[Nyss Nenn]] infiltrated the ship, killing [[Runner (clone)|Runner]] and [[Hunter (clone)|Hunter]], and captured [[Khedryn Faal]], demanding [[Jaden Korr]] to exit into space in a [[hardsuit]] and trade himself in for Faal. However, aboard the supply ship, Faal helped [[Soldier (clone)|Soldier]] to defeat Nenn and retake control of the ship. Faal and Nenn then escaped from the ship aboard separate escape pods. Nyss Nenn's sister, [[Syll Nenn]], tried to destroy Faal's pod, firing at it from her [[Nyss Nenn's scout flyer|scout flyer]] but Korr reflected the shots with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], killing her. Soldier, [[Seer (clone)|Seer]], and [[Grace (Human)|Grace]] escaped aboard the medical supply ship to [[Mother (Rakatan entity)|Mother]], while Nyss Nenn and Korr pursued them on the scout flyer and [[Junker (YT-2400 light freighter)|''Junker'']], respectively.
